title: T460 dialog baseline — expected deltas
description: What a migration batch PROMISES will change in the before/after baseline (spec §6.3 step 5, §3.3). `dialog-baseline.mjs diff --expected <file>` exits 1 on any changed property no entry covers, and reports every entry that matched nothing. PLACEHOLDERS: in the catalog, EVERY entry that carries `dialog: "*"` (the wildcard properties and the concrete width / radius values alike) is there only so the catalog stays one flat list — a batch MUST narrow `dialog` to its own dialogs (and add `from`/`to` where it can) before using them; a wildcard dialog would hide a regression in every other dialog.

batch.description: Free text: which batch this file belongs to (e.g. "1 — pilot").

dialog.description: A route id (`RenameFolderDialog`, `CleanupBulkConfirmDialog#review`) or a glob (`*`, `Mission*`). Matched against the whole id.

property.description: Dotted path into one measurement (see scripts/dev/dialog-routes/measure.mjs), e.g. `card.style.border-top-left-radius`, `scrim.style.background-color`, `card.rect.top`. `*` globs: `card.rect.*`.

from.description: The `before` value (compared as text). Omit to accept any.

to.description: The `after` value (compared as text). Omit to accept any.

height.description: Only at this window height (900 or 560). Omit for both.

theme.description: Only under this data-theme. Omit for all themes.

reason.description: Why — cite the spec row (§3.3) or decision (D1…D9).
